description: Unique quest reward items that cannot be crafted - earned only through completing storylines

wolf_fang_necklace.name: Wolf Fang Necklace
wolf_fang_necklace.description: A necklace of wolf fangs that marks you as a proven wolf hunter
wolf_fang_necklace.flavor: The fangs clatter softly as you move. Wolves sense your prowess and think twice before attacking.

special_effects.wolf_fear: Wolves have a 20% chance to flee when you encounter them

alpha_wolf_pelt.name: Alpha Wolf Pelt
alpha_wolf_pelt.description: The magnificent pelt of an alpha wolf - proof of your victory over the pack leader
alpha_wolf_pelt.flavor: This thick, silver-streaked fur is unmistakable. Victor and other rangers recognize it immediately.

special_effects.ranger_recognition: Rangers and hunters treat you with immediate respect

hunters_cloak.name: Hunter's Cloak
hunters_cloak.description: A masterwork cloak made from alpha wolf fur - the mark of a true ranger
hunters_cloak.flavor: The cloak seems to blend with shadows and undergrowth. You move like a predator.

special_effects.blend_in: +15% chance to avoid random encounters in wilderness

rangers_quiver.name: Ranger's Quiver
rangers_quiver.description: A finely crafted quiver given only to those Victor trusts
rangers_quiver.flavor: The quiver's design steadies your aim. Victor's mark is burned into the leather.

special_effects.steady_aim: Critical hit chance +5% with ranged weapons

tracking_map.name: Tracking Map
tracking_map.description: Victor's hand-drawn map marking wolf trails and dens
tracking_map.flavor: The map shows hidden paths and animal signs only a ranger would notice.

effect.description: +3 to tracking and hunting rolls for 1 hour

greater_healing_potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
greater_healing_potion.description: A powerful healing potion from Victor's ranger contacts
greater_healing_potion.flavor: The potion blazes with golden light. This is no simple apothecary's brew.

tavern_hero_badge.name: Tavern Hero Badge
tavern_hero_badge.description: A badge showing you saved The Prancing Pony from various troubles
tavern_hero_badge.flavor: Bran made this himself. The regulars recognize it and buy you drinks.

special_effects.free_ale_daily: Free ale once per day at The Prancing Pony
special_effects.tavern_recognition: NPCs at the tavern greet you warmly

enchanted_focus_crystal.name: Enchanted Focus Crystal
enchanted_focus_crystal.description: A crystal attuned to magical energies by Elowen herself
enchanted_focus_crystal.flavor: The crystal pulses with soft light, responding to your thoughts.

special_effects.mana_sense: Can detect magical items and creatures

fey_blessing.name: Fey Blessing
fey_blessing.description: A blessing bestowed by the fey themselves - nature responds to your presence
fey_blessing.flavor: An otherworldly shimmer surrounds you. Plants seem to lean toward you, and small creatures show no fear.

special_effects.fey_daily_gift: Once per day, receive a bonus rare item when gathering in the Feywilds
special_effects.nature_affinity: Animals are friendlier and easier to tame

fey_touched_ring.name: Fey Touched Ring
fey_touched_ring.description: A ring infused with fey magic - it glimmers with an inner light
fey_touched_ring.flavor: The ring changes color with your mood. Sometimes it whispers secrets of the forest.

special_effects.fey_sight: Can see hidden fey creatures and paths
special_effects.gathering_luck: +10% chance to find rare items when gathering

sparkbeam_scroll.name: Sparkbeam Scroll
sparkbeam_scroll.description: A scroll containing the Sparkbeam spell - deals extra damage to your next hunt target
sparkbeam_scroll.flavor: Fey writing dances across the parchment. When read aloud, a beam of concentrated starlight streaks forth.

vip_tavern_pass.name: VIP Tavern Pass
vip_tavern_pass.description: A special pass marking you as a VIP at The Prancing Pony
vip_tavern_pass.flavor: Bran's signature is on the back. 'For service above and beyond - drinks on the house!'

special_effects.bran_discount: 15% discount on all purchases from Bran
special_effects.free_meal_daily: One free meal per day at The Prancing Pony
special_effects.vip_seating: Access to the best table in the tavern

item_recognition.description: When NPCs see players with these items, they may comment on them

wolf_fang_necklace.victor: That necklace... you earned every fang on it. I'm proud of you.
wolf_fang_necklace.bran: Is that a wolf fang necklace? You've been busy out in the wilds!
wolf_fang_necklace.elowen: Interesting trophies. The wolves must have put up quite a fight.

hunters_cloak.victor: Wearing that cloak marks you as one of us. Welcome, ranger-friend.
hunters_cloak.bran: That's quite the cloak! Victor doesn't give those out lightly.
hunters_cloak.cassian: A hunter's cloak! I'll give you a fair price on anything you bring in.

alpha_wolf_pelt.victor: You kept the pelt. Good. It's a reminder of what you accomplished.
alpha_wolf_pelt.any: Is that... an alpha wolf pelt? You must be quite the hunter.
